import sys,copy,json
sys.path[:0]=["/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8/agent-dev-kit/src","/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8/agent-dev-kit/tests"]
import test_execution_policy as t
from agent_dev_kit.execution_policy import reduce_events,evaluate
readonly=t.goal_intake("readonly","readonly",kind="goal-replan",decision_id="replan-readonly-older",minute=3)
implementation=t.goal_intake("implementation","implementation",kind="goal-replan",decision_id="replan-implementation-newer",minute=4)
base=t.completed_events_without_artifacts("implementation","implementation")
def update(i,intake):
    return t.event(i,"goal.updated",{"intake":copy.deepcopy(intake),"mode_change_reason":"replan"},minute=7)
for name,replans,verifier in [
 ("latest_implementation",[update(20,readonly),update(21,implementation)],t.managed_mode_verifier),
 ("replayed_older_readonly_new_event_id",[update(20,readonly),update(21,implementation),update(22,readonly)],t.managed_mode_verifier),
 ("replay_without_trusted_verifier",[update(20,readonly),update(21,implementation),update(22,readonly)],None),
]:
    events=copy.deepcopy(base[:7])+replans+copy.deepcopy(base[7:])
    state=reduce_events(events)
    decision=evaluate(state,t.policy_v2(),gate_event="final",mode_authority_verifier=verifier,as_of=t.AS_OF)
    print(json.dumps({"case":name,"intake_revision":state["goal"]["intake_revision"],"task_mode":decision["task_mode"],"effective_artifact_mode":decision["effective_artifact_mode"],"missing_artifacts":decision["missing_artifacts"],"gate_allowed":decision["gate_allowed"],"completion_allowed":decision["completion_allowed"],"managed_verifier":verifier is not None}))
